text: so does it not make it into the @cart/hmsc-int/editors/model/Studio.tsx then? how do i paint it
resolution: Answered 'how do I paint it': today the generated mesh does NOT enter Studio — genprop bakes a static render-only ImportedProp; painting requires a Studio EditMesh with UVs. Built and committed the durable bridge that closes that gap: cart/hmsc-int/editors/model/importMesh.ts (glbToTriangles + trianglesToEditMesh weld + glbToEditMesh convenience = unwrap(trianglesToEditMesh(...))), the inverse of editMeshToGeometry. Confirmed all the Studio machinery needed already exists: addPart() injects any EditMesh, unwrap() handles arbitrary triangle meshes (shelf-packs a per-face UV island; box-net only for clean 6-face boxes), and the pixel painter just needs face.uv. Proven: importMesh.test.ts 5/5 PASS + a temp probe over the REAL generated hydrant GLB (converts, welds, every face unwrapped -> paintable). Committed 04bb64cb5. LAST MILE NOT DONE: the Studio import entry point (a small button/dialog calling readFileBase64 -> glbToEditMesh -> studioNewModel + addPart) requires editing Studio.tsx, which session be97 is ACTIVELY editing (mtime 21:54, 36 lines uncommitted) — I refused to edit it concurrently to avoid clobbering unstaged work. Needs coordination or a go-ahead once that file is free; alternative store-injection path was rejected as fragile (couples to V20 event store).
